rationale: This is clearly a motor vehicle collision claim involving significant vehicle damage (totaled vehicle) and personal injury (whiplash and sprained wrist) from a rear-end accident, covered under the auto policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003, auto full coverage, $750 deductible, $100,000 limit, active status) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday at a red light. The other vehicle struck claimant's vehicle at approximately 35 mph without braking, totaling the vehicle with severe structural damage (trunk crushed into back seat). Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. Claim classified as auto with 0.95 confidence and high severity due to total loss vehicle and documented personal injuries.

case_facts.incident_type: rear-end collision, other vehicle struck claimant's vehicle at approximately 35 mph without braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: A motor vehicle parked in the driveway sustained damage (smashed hood and windshield) from a falling tree; this is a covered auto claim even though the tree originated on the claimant's own property.
claim_summary: Policy POL-1005 (Riley Kim, active bundle_home_auto, $1,000 deductible, $400,000 limit): A maple tree from the claimant's front yard fell in wind last night and landed on the claimant's car parked in the driveway, causing damage to the hood and windshield. Classified as auto damage with high confidence (0.95). Severity: medium, due to damage to multiple vehicle components without reported injuries. The claim is within coverage and ready for auto adjuster review.

case_facts.description: maple tree fell in wind and landed on parked car, damaging hood and windshield
